product_one_liner.value: Levitate helps relationship-driven small businesses stay in touch with clients and prospects through AI-assisted personalized marketing, email, texting, social media and automated follow-ups.

pricing_page.notes: Public plan and feature details are available; dollar pricing requires a demo or quote.

value: Jeffrey Allen Howard Attorney at Law PLLC

eng_blog.notes: The public blog contains marketing advice, product announcements and updates, rather than an engineer-authored technical publication.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The five listed openings contain no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title; Revenue Insights Coordinator is an operations/reporting role.

model_provider.value: Anthropic PBC; Google LLC; OpenAI, LLC

compliance_certs.notes: Exact public labels are “SOC 2 Type II,” “HIPAA-enabled,” and “PCI DSS (SAQ A).” HIPAA-enabled is a compliance claim, not a separate HIPAA certification; PCI DSS is qualified as SAQ A.

last_funding.notes: Announced March 5, 2026. The company reports $16 million without a series label; PitchBook labels it Series E. Other databases classify this round as Series D or Series D-II.

raised_18mo.notes: The March 5, 2026 announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Sales Development Representative opening in Tampa, with a stated path to an AE role.

launched_6mo.notes: September 25, 2026: introduced Meeting Prep, Keep in Touch Agent, Email Exec Assistant and the Levitate MCP Server; within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Anna McMahon’s profile lists her Levitate SVP of Sales tenure as June 2025–April 2026; her April 2026 departure is inside the window. Her June 2025 arrival is outside it.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Internal-use evidence: the Account Executive Manager posting requires consistent use of HubSpot. The other named CRM, donor-management and marketing systems are listed product integrations, not proof of Levitate’s own internal stack.
